results.name: crash-before-fsync
results.invariant: No durable claim means no execution evidence was fabricated.

results.name: crash-after-fsync-before-spawn
results.invariant: A durable claim permanently rejects a second spawn.

results.name: duplicate-connectors
results.invariant: Exclusive claim creation permits only one connector winner.

results.name: ambiguous-restart
results.invariant: Claimed work without a terminal becomes unknown and never replays.

results.name: post-terminal-pre-ack
results.invariant: Terminal outbox survives until an idempotent delivery marker exists.

results.name: terminal-replay-sentinel
results.invariant: The original terminal dispatch is rejected after cache pruning.

results.name: stdout-overflow
results.invariant: Stdout overflow is distinct and bounded.

results.name: stderr-overflow
results.invariant: Stderr overflow is distinct and never customer content.

results.name: ignored-sigterm
results.invariant: Ignored SIGTERM escalates to SIGKILL within a bound.

results.name: close-hang
results.invariant: A child that never closes resolves as close_timeout.

results.name: presence-telemetry-contention-queue
results.invariant: Presence/telemetry failure and runtime unknown do not violate capacity one.
